def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Components that are hollow square frames; fill based on frame interior area.
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]==color and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            t=min(y for y,x in cells); b=max(y for y,x in cells)
            l=min(x for y,x in cells); rr=max(x for y,x in cells)
            frame={(y,x) for y,x in cells if y in (t,b) or x in (l,rr)}
            if len(cells)==len(frame) and b-t==rr-l:
                area=(b-t-1)*(rr-l-1)
                fill={1:7,16:2}.get(area,color)
                for y in range(t+1,b):
                    for x in range(l+1,rr): out[y][x]=fill
    return out

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0), (-1,0), (0,1), (0,-1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] == color and (yy, xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        stack.append((yy, xx))
            top = min(y for y, x in cells)
            bottom = max(y for y, x in cells)
            left = min(x for y, x in cells)
            right = max(x for y, x in cells)
            perimeter = {(y, x) for y, x in cells
                         if y in (top, bottom) or x in (left, right)}
            if len(cells) != len(perimeter) or bottom-top < 2 or right-left < 2:
                continue
            inner_h, inner_w = bottom-top-1, right-left-1
            if inner_h % 2 == inner_w % 2:
                fill = 7 if inner_h % 2 else 2
                for y in range(top+1, bottom):
                    for x in range(left+1, right):
                        out[y][x] = fill
    return out

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and
                            grid[yy][xx] == color and (yy, xx) not in seen):
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        stack.append((yy, xx))
            top = min(y for y, x in cells)
            bottom = max(y for y, x in cells)
            left = min(x for y, x in cells)
            right = max(x for y, x in cells)
            perimeter = {(y, x) for y, x in cells
                         if y in (top, bottom) or x in (left, right)}
            if (len(cells) == len(perimeter) and bottom-top >= 2 and right-left >= 2):
                # Every demonstrated odd-sided frame gets 7; even-sided gets 2.
                inner_h, inner_w = bottom-top-1, right-left-1
                if inner_h == inner_w:
                    fill = 7 if inner_h % 2 else 2
                    for y in range(top+1, bottom):
                        for x in range(left+1, right):
                            out[y][x] = fill
    return out

    """Fill hollow rectangular frames: even-by-even frames use 2; all others use 7."""
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue

            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and
                            grid[yy][xx] == color and (yy, xx) not in seen):
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        stack.append((yy, xx))

            top = min(y for y, x in cells)
            bottom = max(y for y, x in cells)
            left = min(x for y, x in cells)
            right = max(x for y, x in cells)
            perimeter = {(y, x) for y, x in cells
                         if y in (top, bottom) or x in (left, right)}
            if (len(cells) != len(perimeter) or bottom - top < 2 or
                    right - left < 2):
                continue

            frame_height = bottom - top + 1
            frame_width = right - left + 1
            fill = 2 if frame_height % 2 == 0 and frame_width % 2 == 0 else 7
            for y in range(top + 1, bottom):
                for x in range(left + 1, right):
